basis: Executable differential between the pinned original shared HTTP boundary (real Node 8.9.4 with the pinned reference express/body-parser) and Phoenix packages/common/src/service.js, covering the C-01 acceptance dimensions the earlier bounded 317-case review did not reach.
command: docker run --rm --network none --mount type=bind,source=<reference>,target=/reference,readonly --mount type=bind,source=<review>,target=/review node:8.9.4-slim node /review/original-boundary.cjs && node phoenix-boundary.mjs /home/shell/work/phoenix phoenix-boundary.json && node compare-boundary.mjs

acceptanceReview.text: Compare null, undefined, arrays, empty bodies, malformed JSON, handler errors, unknown routes, trailing slashes and supported HTTP methods.
acceptanceReview.evidence: Body dimensions (null/undefined/arrays/empty/malformed JSON) were already covered by the accepted 317-case review at .parity/reviews/http-json-errors (0 differences, hashes re-verified by this root). This run adds the remaining five dimensions as 47 executable cases: 12 unknown-route cases, 8 trailing-slash cases, 14 HTTP-method cases across GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH/HEAD/OPTIONS on both known and unknown routes, 2 handler-error cases (uncoded throw -> 500, statusCode-carrying throw -> 418), plus healthcheck ordering. All 47 identical.

acceptanceReview.text: Preserve reference status codes, response bodies, content types and headers on all service boundaries.
acceptanceReview.evidence: Every case compares status code, response body, content-type and the Allow header. 47/47 identical, including the OPTIONS Allow value "GET,HEAD,POST,PUT,DELETE" and the exact 404 error envelope {type:ERROR, msgID, ts, final:true, data:{message:"URL not found: <path>"}} produced by the source app.use 404 + buildErrorMessage pair.
acceptanceReview.qualification: "All service boundaries" is verified at the SHARED boundary that every service is built on (packages/common/src/service.js vs BaseService.ts), not by enumerating each deployed service. Per-service route contracts are owned by their own tasks (A-01 mapping, A-02 dispatch/auth, S-*, Q-*).

comparatorHonesty.method: Ran the comparator with --falsify, corrupting every source status to 599 and every source body.
comparatorHonesty.result: reported 94 differences, so the comparator is not vacuously passing.

correctionsMade: First run reported 2 body differences on /healthcheck (source "OK" vs phoenix "ok"). Root read BaseService.getHealthcheckResponse, which returns {statusCode:200, body:'ok'} lowercase. The HARNESS was wrong and Phoenix was right; the harness was corrected and the original capture re-run. Recorded here rather than silently fixed.

normalisation.msgID/ts: Nondeterministic in both implementations (source uses getUUID() and Date.now()); replaced with placeholders on both sides.
normalisation.x-powered-by: Express banner, not a product contract. Compared but reported as observation only; 0 observed.
normalisation.content-length: Derived from the body; compared via the body itself so an identical body cannot fail twice.

limitations: Shared boundary only. Per-service route/auth contracts belong to A-01, A-02 and the service tasks.
HTTPS/TLS framing, websocket upgrade paths and streaming/raw-upload routes are not exercised here.
The source app is reconstructed from BaseService.ts middleware order rather than booting a full Pegasus service; the reconstruction is in original-boundary.cjs and is reviewable.
Body-parser limit/charset/encoding edge cases beyond the accepted 317-case set are not re-tested.
